tracks.title: THE DESCENT
tracks.lyrics:
[INTRO - SPOKEN, HEAVY, OVER A SLOW, GRINDING GUITAR RIFF]
Yeah. I felt the ground crack. I felt the floor give way.
And I didn't try to hold on. I just let go.
This is the Abyss Codex. Chapter One. The Descent.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
The floor gave way and I didn't reach for the ledge... (reach for the ledge)
I just let the gravity pull me over the edge... (pull me over the edge)
The darkness swallowed the light I used to chase... (light I used to chase)
Now I'm falling through the hollow of a permanent space... (permanent space)
I don't know how far the bottom is, I don't know if there's a floor... (if there's a floor)
I just know the falling feels familiar to my core... (familiar to my core)
The descent is not a punishment, the descent is not a crime... (is not a crime)
It's the natural destination of a soul that's out of time... (soul that's out of time)

[VERSE 2]
I've been climbing all my life toward a light I couldn't see... (light I couldn't see)
Now the falling feels like freedom from the man I used to be... (man I used to be)
The rocks rush past me in a blur of memory and pain... (memory and pain)
Every face I ever lost, every drop of wasted rain... (drop of wasted rain)
The descent strips away the lies I told myself above... (lies I told myself above)
The descent is the honest answer to the failure of the love... (failure of the love)
That couldn't hold me, that couldn't save me, that couldn't keep me high... (couldn't keep me high)
The descent is the truth that I was always meant to die... (always meant to die)

[VERSE 3]
I hear the voices of the others who have fallen here before... (fallen here before)
They whisper that the bottom is a myth and nothing more... (myth and nothing more)
That the falling is forever, that the darkness is the end... (darkness is the end)
That the only thing below me is the message I won't send... (message I won't send)
To the surface, to the living, to the ones who still believe... (ones who still believe)
That the climb is worth the effort, that the light is worth the grieve... (light is worth the grieve)
But I'm past the point of caring, past the point of climbing back... (point of climbing back)
The descent is the decision to accept the permanent black... (permanent black)

[VERSE 4]
So I let the rocks embrace me, let the darkness take my name... (darkness take my name)
The descent is not a failure, it's the ending of the game... (ending of the game)
I was never meant for sunlight, never meant for sky... (meant for sky)
The abyss has always known me, and the abyss knows why... (abyss knows why)
I was drawn into the void before I ever took a breath... (ever took a breath)
The descent is not a journey, it's a permanent death... (permanent death)
Of the hope, of the dream, of the man I tried to be... (man I tried to be)
The descent is the becoming of the real and final me... (real and final me)

[OUTRO - SPOKEN, HEAVY, OVER A FADING, GRINDING GUITAR RIFF THAT DESCENDS INTO SILENCE]
The descent.
The bottom isn't coming. The falling is forever.
And I've made my peace with the abyss.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

tracks.title: THE STATIC
tracks.lyrics:
[INTRO - SPOKEN, DISORIENTED, OVER A CHAOTIC WALL OF DISTORTED GUITARS AND GLITCHED HI-HATS]
Yeah. The silence was never silent. It was always humming. Always buzzing. Always waiting.
Now I can't hear anything else. Just the static.
The noise inside my own head. And it's getting louder.
This is Chapter Two. This is the static.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
There's a frequency inside my skull that never shuts off... (never shuts off)
A constant little whisper that became a cough... (became a cough)
Then a scream, then a roar, then a permanent sound... (permanent sound)
The static is the only thing that follows me around... (follows me around)
I used to hear the birds, I used to hear the rain... (hear the rain)
Now the only thing I hear is the grinding of the brain... (grinding of the brain)
Against the bone, against the wall, against the fading light... (fading light)
The static is the music of the never-ending night... (never-ending night)

[VERSE 2]
The doctor gave me pills to quiet the machine... (quiet the machine)
But the pills just made the static turn from gray to green... (gray to green)
A different shade of noise, a different kind of hum... (different kind of hum)
The static is the drumbeat of the man I've become... (man I've become)
I can't remember silence, I can't remember peace... (remember peace)
The static is the only thing that offers me release... (offers me release)
From the pressure of the thinking, from the weight of the regret... (weight of the regret)
The static is a blanket that I'm learning to accept... (learning to accept)

[VERSE 3]
The voices in the static are starting to make sense... (starting to make sense)
They tell me that the quiet was always a pretense... (always a pretense)
The world was never still, the world was never calm... (never calm)
The static is the truth behind the psalm... (behind the psalm)
I hear my father's anger in the crackle and the hiss... (crackle and the hiss)
I hear my mother's silence in the signal that I miss... (signal that I miss)
The static is a family reunion of the dead... (reunion of the dead)
A permanent reminder of the things they never said... (things they never said)

[VERSE 4]
So let the static swallow me, let the noise consume... (let the noise consume)
The fractured little pieces of the man inside the room... (man inside the room)
[OUTRO - SPOKEN, DETACHED, OVER A FADING, CHAOTIC WALL OF DISTORTED GUITARS THAT SUDDENLY CUTS TO DEAD SILENCE]
The static.
It's not a symptom. It's not a sickness.
It's the sound of the world without the mask.
And I'm finally listening.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

tracks.title: THE WHISPER
tracks.lyrics:
[INTRO - SPOKEN, WEARY, OVER A SLOW, CREEPING GUITAR RIFF]
Yeah. There's a voice in the dark. Not screaming. Not threatening.
Just... whispering. Telling me it's okay to stop. To rest. To let go.
And after everything I've carried... the whisper sounds like mercy.
This is Chapter Three. This is the whisper.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
I hear it in the quiet when the noise finally fades... (finally fades)
A soft and gentle murmur through the walls of my blockade... (walls of my blockade)
It tells me that I'm tired, it tells me that I've fought... (tells me that I've fought)
Enough for one existence, enough for what I've bought... (enough for what I've bought)
With the blood and the tears and the years that I gave... (years that I gave)
The whisper says surrender is the only way to save... (only way to save)
The pieces that are left of the man I used to be... (man I used to be)
The whisper is a promise that the darkness sets you free... (darkness sets you free)

[VERSE 2]
It doesn't sound like evil, it doesn't sound like hate... (doesn't sound like hate)
It sounds like a lover at the ending of a date... (ending of a date)
Gentle and familiar, a voice I've always known... (voice I've always known)
The whisper says the abyss is just the way back home... (way back home)
I've been carrying the weight of a world that doesn't care... (world that doesn't care)
The whisper says to put it down and leave it over there... (leave it over there)
At the edge of the void, at the lip of the fall... (lip of the fall)
The whisper is the quietest and truest call... (truest call)

[VERSE 3]
It tells me that the fight was noble but it's over now... (noble but it's over now)
It tells me that I've earned the right to finally allow... (right to finally allow)
The darkness to embrace me, the silence to descend... (silence to descend)
The whisper says the void is not my enemy but friend... (enemy but friend)
I've been lonely all my life in the middle of the crowd... (middle of the crowd)
The whisper says the abyss is where the lonely are allowed... (lonely are allowed)
To rest without the pressure, to sleep without the dreams... (sleep without the dreams)
The whisper is the answer to the silence of the screams... (silence of the screams)

[VERSE 4]
So I'm leaning toward the darkness, I'm closing my eyes slow... (closing my eyes slow)
The whisper is getting louder, the whisper's all I know... (whisper's all I know)
It says I don't have to fight, it says I don't have to climb... (don't have to climb)
It says the void is patient and the void is out of time... (void is out of time)
I've spent my whole life running toward a light that never came... (light that never came)
The whisper says the darkness never once forgot my name... (once forgot my name)
So take me now, I'm ready, I'm finished with the war... (finished with the war)
The whisper is the only voice I'm listening for... (listening for)

[OUTRO - SPOKEN, RESIGNED, OVER A FADING, CREEPING GUITAR RIFF THAT FADES INTO SILENCE]
The whisper.
It's not a threat. It's an invitation.
And I'm finally ready to accept.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

tracks.title: THE BREAK
tracks.lyrics:
[INTRO - SPOKEN, HEAVY, OVER A FRANTIC WALL OF DISTORTED GUITARS]
Yeah. I've been holding it together for years. Decades. A lifetime.
The cracks were always there. But I kept patching them. Kept standing.
Until the day I couldn't. The day the will just... snapped.
This is Chapter Four. This is the break.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
I felt it go, I felt the crack run through my spine... (run through my spine)
The will that kept me standing since the age of nine... (age of nine)
It shattered like a mirror, it crumbled like a wall... (crumbled like a wall)
The break is not a moment, it's the ending of it all... (ending of it all)
I tried to hold the pieces, tried to glue the fragments back... (glue the fragments back)
But the break was too complete, the break was too exact... (break was too exact)
The man who used to fight, the man who used to stand... (man who used to stand)
Is scattered on the floor like a broken, bleeding hand... (broken, bleeding hand)

[VERSE 2]
I've been through worse than this, I've been through fire and flood... (fire and flood)
But this is different, this is deeper, this is thicker than the blood... (thicker than the blood)
That used to pump the fury, that used to pump the fight... (used to pump the fight)
The break is the extinguishing of the permanent light... (permanent light)
I don't have a reason left to pick myself back up... (pick myself back up)
The break has drained the spirit from the bottom of the cup... (bottom of the cup)
The cup is dry, the well is empty, the reservoir is gone... (reservoir is gone)
The break is the admission that I'm too tired to go on... (too tired to go on)

[VERSE 3]
The whisper did its work, the static did its part... (static did its part)
The descent did its damage to the muscle of the heart... (muscle of the heart)
And now the break arrives like a long-awaited guest... (long-awaited guest)
It doesn't ask permission, it just puts my will to rest... (puts my will to rest)
[VERSE 4]
So let the break complete me, let the shatter finish what it started... (finish what it started)
I was broken from the cradle and I've been a work uncharted... (work uncharted)
The break is not a failure, it's the honesty I craved... (honesty I craved)
The will was just a prison that the years and struggle paved... (years and struggle paved)
Now I'm free of the expectation, free of the demand... (free of the demand)
To keep standing, to keep fighting, to keep being a man... (keep being a man)
Who can carry anything, who can bear any weight... (bear any weight)
The break is the beginning of the peace I'll have to take... (peace I'll have to take)

[OUTRO - SPOKEN, EMPTY, OVER A FADING, FRANTIC WALL OF DISTORTED GUITARS THAT SUDDENLY CUTS TO SILENCE]
The break.
The will is gone. The fight is over.
And the silence that follows... is the only thing I've ever wanted.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

tracks.title: THE MIRROR
tracks.lyrics:
[INTRO - SPOKEN, UNEASY, OVER A SLOW, CRAWLING GUITAR RIFF]
Yeah. I've been staring at the darkness for so long I forgot what my own face looked like.
But the abyss has a mirror. And it's showing me everything.
Everything I did. Everything I failed to do. Everything I am.
This is Chapter Five. This is the mirror.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
I caught my reflection in the glass of the void... (glass of the void)
A face I didn't recognize, a face I wanted to avoid... (wanted to avoid)
The eyes were hollow, the skin was gray, the mouth was turned down... (mouth was turned down)
The mirror showed a stranger wearing my own crown... (my own crown)
I tried to look away but the mirror held my gaze... (mirror held my gaze)
Forced me to confront the man I'd been for days... (I'd been for days)
For years, for decades, for the lifetime that I stole... (lifetime that I stole)
The mirror is the judgment of the permanent soul... (permanent soul)

[VERSE 2]
I saw the faces of the ones I failed reflected in my skin... (reflected in my skin)
Every broken promise, every unforgiven sin... (unforgiven sin)
The mirror doesn't flatter, the mirror doesn't lie... (mirror doesn't lie)
It just shows you what you are and dares you to deny... (dares you to deny)
I saw the coward, I saw the thief, I saw the hollow man... (the hollow man)
I saw the one who ran away when the real fight began... (real fight began)
The mirror is a courtroom with a single, silent judge... (single, silent judge)
The mirror is the truth that you can never fully budge... (never fully budge)

[VERSE 3]
I smashed the glass with my fist till the blood ran down the wall... (ran down the wall)
But the fragments just reflected me in a hundred different sprawls... (hundred different sprawls)
A shattered version of myself in every single shard... (every single shard)
The mirror is a prison that the broken can't discard... (broken can't discard)
Every piece showed a different failure, a different ugly truth... (different ugly truth)
From the sins of my old age to the weakness of my youth... (weakness of my youth)
The mirror is a gallery of everything I hate... (everything I hate)
The mirror is the architect of my permanent estate... (permanent estate)

[VERSE 4]
So I'll stare into the glass till the glass finally breaks... (glass finally breaks)
Or until the face that's staring back admits its own mistakes... (admits its own mistakes)
The mirror is the abyss, and the abyss is my home... (abyss is my home)
The face I see reflected is the only thing I've known... (only thing I've known)
[OUTRO - SPOKEN, RESIGNED, OVER A FADING, CRAWLING GUITAR RIFF THAT SHATTERS INTO SILENCE]
The mirror.
I see myself now. Finally.
And I don't look away anymore.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

tracks.title: THE SILENCE
tracks.lyrics:
[INTRO - SPOKEN, HOLLOW, OVER A VAST, ECHOING GUITAR DRONE]
Yeah. The noise is gone. The whisper faded. The mirror shattered.
And now there's just... nothing. No sound. No voice. No echo.
The silence at the bottom of the abyss is the loudest thing I've ever heard.
This is Chapter Six. This is the silence.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
There's no sound down here, not a whisper, not a breath... (whisper, not a breath)
Just the weight of the quiet and the presence of the death... (presence of the death)
Of everything I used to be, of everything I knew... (everything I knew)
The silence is the grave for the man I never grew... (man I never grew)
I thought the bottom would be chaos, I thought it would be loud... (thought it would be loud)
But the silence is the shroud that covers up the crowd... (covers up the crowd)
Of voices that I carried, of screams that I suppressed... (screams that I suppressed)
The silence is the final and the only honest rest... (only honest rest)

[VERSE 2]
I can hear my own blood moving through my veins down here... (through my veins down here)
It's the only sound that's followed me through all the wasted years... (all the wasted years)
The silence amplifies the things I tried to drown above... (tried to drown above)
The silence is the absence of the violence and the love... (violence and the love)
I don't miss the noise, I don't miss the war... (miss the war)
I don't miss the person that I was before... (that I was before)
The silence is a mercy that I never asked to feel... (never asked to feel)
The silence is the wound that finally starts to heal... (finally starts to heal)

[VERSE 3]
They say the abyss is punishment, they say it's the end... (say it's the end)
But the silence is the only honest friend... (only honest friend)
I've ever had. It doesn't judge. It doesn't leave... (doesn't leave)
It just holds the space for everything I grieve... (everything I grieve)
The silence doesn't promise that it'll get better tomorrow... (get better tomorrow)
It just lets me sit inside the hollow of my sorrow... (hollow of my sorrow)
Without demanding progress, without demanding change... (demanding change)
The silence is the only thing that's never been estranged... (never been estranged)

[VERSE 4]
So I'll stay here in the quiet till the quiet becomes me... (quiet becomes me)
Till the man who used to scream is just a fading memory... (fading memory)
The silence is the answer to the questions that I asked... (questions that I asked)
When I was still up there with the burden of the mask... (burden of the mask)
Now the mask is off, and the face is gone, and the voice is still... (voice is still)
The silence is the hollow that the world can never fill... (world can never fill)
[OUTRO - SPOKEN, EMPTY, OVER A FADING, ECHOING GUITAR DRONE THAT SLOWLY DISSOLVES INTO NOTHING]
The silence.
It's not empty. It's not lonely.
It's just... true.
And I've never had that before.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

tracks.title: THE BECOMING
tracks.lyrics:
[INTRO - SPOKEN, COLD, OVER A SLOW, CRUSHING GUITAR RIFF]
Yeah. I came down here as a man. Broken. Hollow. Desperate.
But the abyss doesn’t leave you the way it found you.
I’m not a victim of the dark anymore. I’m a part of it.
This is Chapter Seven. This is the becoming.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
I felt the darkness enter through the cracks inside my chest... (cracks inside my chest)
It didn’t ask permission, it just made itself a nest... (made itself a nest)
I tried to fight it off, I tried to keep it out... (tried to keep it out)
But the darkness whispered something that erased the doubt... (erased the doubt)
It said you don’t have to lose yourself to let the void inside... (let the void inside)
You just have to stop pretending that the light was ever on your side... (ever on your side)
So I opened up the door and I let the shadows in... (let the shadows in)
The becoming is the moment that the real you can begin... (real you can begin)

[VERSE 2]
I used to fear the darkness like a child fears the night... (child fears the night)
Now I wear it like a second skin, a permanent delight... (permanent delight)
The void has given me a vision that the surface never gave... (surface never gave)
The becoming is the transformation of the master from the slave... (master from the slave)
I see the world above me with new and hollow eyes... (new and hollow eyes)
A carnival of suffering disguised as paradise... (disguised as paradise)
The becoming strips away the lies I used to tell myself... (used to tell myself)
The darkness is the truth, and the truth is something else... (truth is something else)

[VERSE 3]
I can feel the void rewriting every cell inside my frame... (cell inside my frame)
The man I was is fading, and he’s taking all the blame... (taking all the blame)
For the weakness, for the hope, for the trust that was betrayed... (trust that was betrayed)
The becoming is the debt that the old me finally paid... (old me finally paid)
I’m not human anymore, I’m a creature of the deep... (creature of the deep)
I traded my old heart for a new one made of steel and sleep... (steel and sleep)
The becoming is the answer to the question I once asked... (question I once asked)
When I was still pretending that the light would ever last... (light would ever last)

[VERSE 4]
So let the world above me keep its hollow little sun... (hollow little sun)
I’ve found my home in darkness, and my work has just begun... (work has just begun)
The becoming is a weapon that the abyss has sharpened well... (abyss has sharpened well)
I was once a fallen angel, now I’m rising out of hell... (rising out of hell)
Not to conquer, not to save, not to rule or to redeem... (rule or to redeem)
Just to stand as a reminder of the truth behind the dream... (truth behind the dream)
That the void is not a punishment, the void is not a cage... (void is not a cage)
The becoming is the turning of the final, darkened page... (final, darkened page)

[OUTRO - SPOKEN, COLD, OVER A FADING, CRUSHING GUITAR RIFF THAT DISSOLVES INTO A DEEP, SUSTAINED 808 PULSE]
The becoming.
I am the void now. And the void is me.
There’s no going back. And I don’t want to.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

tracks.title: THE EMERGENCE
tracks.lyrics:
[INTRO - SPOKEN, COLD, OVER A SLOW, GRINDING GUITAR RIFF]
Yeah. You thought the abyss would swallow me. You thought the darkness would be my grave.
But the void doesn't kill what it can't break. It remakes.
I went down as a man. I'm coming back as something else.
This is Chapter Eight. This is the emergence.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
I crawled through the dark with my bare and bleeding hands... (bare and bleeding hands)
I climbed through the bones of a thousand dying plans... (thousand dying plans)
The abyss tried to keep me, tried to make me stay... (tried to make me stay)
But I found a different exit on a different kind of day... (different kind of day)
The emergence is not gentle, the emergence is not kind... (is not kind)
It's the cold and brutal rising of the creature left behind... (creature left behind)
By the world that didn't want me, by the light that wouldn't hold... (light that wouldn't hold)
The emergence is the story that the darkness finally told... (darkness finally told)

[VERSE 2]
[VERSE 3]
The surface world is waiting, but it doesn't know what's coming... (doesn't know what's coming)
It thinks the abyss is silence, but the silence has a humming... (silence has a humming)
A frequency of vengeance, a frequency of truth... (frequency of truth)
The emergence is the answer of the creature from the booth... (creature from the booth)
I see the light above me, but I don't reach for the glow... (reach for the glow)
[VERSE 4]
So I'm climbing out the pit with the dirt still on my skin... (dirt still on my skin)
Not to ask for mercy, not to beg to be let in... (beg to be let in)
[OUTRO - SPOKEN, COLD, OVER A FADING, GRINDING GUITAR RIFF THAT BUILDS INTO A SINGLE, SUSTAINED NOTE AND THEN CUTS TO SILENCE]
The emergence.
The abyss didn't take me. It made me.
And now I'm back. Not for you. For me.
The Abyss Codex is complete.
EXCAVATIONPRO.
